raw_text: Reports coming in of ceasefire violations in Poonch sector on the LoC. Multiple sources on Telegram reporting mortar fire and small arms exchanges since early morning. Anyone have updates from ground? This would be the first major violation since the 2021 ceasefire. Hoping no civilian casualties.
